tp-link-300-mbps-wi-fi-router.summary: A 4G LTE router from TP-Link: put a Nano SIM card in and it shares mobile internet over 300 Mbps Wi-Fi and four wired ports. It suits a small office or home where fixed broadband is missing or unreliable, and it can also run on a cable connection with 4G as a backup.
highlights: 4G LTE Cat4 with up to 150 Mbps download
Nano SIM slot, no setup software needed
Four 10/100 Mbps Ethernet ports, one can act as WAN
specs: 3 x 10/100 Mbps LAN, 1 x 10/100 Mbps LAN/WAN
Guest network, WAN failover, Wi-Fi on/off button, WPS

ubiquiti-unifi-dual-radio-ap.summary: A Ubiquiti UniFi ceiling access point with two radios, one on 2.4 GHz and one on 5 GHz, for reliable Wi-Fi across offices, shops, hotels and larger homes. It is powered over the network cable (PoE), so only one cable runs to the ceiling, and it is set up and monitored from the UniFi Network app.
highlights: Dual-radio Wi-Fi on 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz
Powered by PoE over a single Ethernet cable
Managed centrally from the UniFi Network app
Add more UniFi access points as the site grows
specs: UniFi Network application (UniFi console or app)

d-link-wi-fi-router.summary: A D-Link wireless router for homes and small offices: it connects to your internet line and shares it over Wi-Fi and wired Ethernet ports. Setup is done from a web browser or the D-Link app, depending on the model.
highlights: Shares one internet connection with many devices
Suited to homes and small offices

d-link-4g-lte-dwr-1920-router.summary: A D-Link 4G LTE router: insert a SIM card and it shares mobile internet over Wi-Fi and Ethernet. It is useful as a main connection where there is no fixed line, or as a backup when the main line goes down.
highlights: Mobile internet from a 4G SIM card
Wi-Fi and wired Ethernet for local devices

d-link-des-1008c-switch.summary: A small 8-port D-Link switch that adds more wired connections to your network. It is plug and play with no setup, runs silently without a fan, and saves power automatically when a port is idle. A good fit for a desk, a home office or a small shop network running at 10/100 Mbps.
highlights: Auto MDI/MDIX, any network cable works

d-link-des-1005c-switch.summary: A small 5-port D-Link switch that adds more wired connections to your network. It is plug and play with no setup, runs silently without a fan, and saves power automatically when a port is idle. A good fit for a desk, a home office or a small shop network running at 10/100 Mbps.
highlights: Auto MDI/MDIX, any network cable works

24-port-gigabit-switch.summary: A 24-port Gigabit Ethernet switch for the core of an office or building network. It connects computers, servers, access points and cameras at up to 1 Gbps per port and mounts in a standard 19 inch rack. The listing describes Layer 3 routing and redundant power support for networks that need to stay up.
specs: Up to 1 Gbps per port, full duplex
19 inch rack, rack ears included (per listing)

wi-fi-6-enterprise-router.summary: A business grade Wi-Fi 6 router for offices that need fast, stable wireless for many users. Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) handles crowded networks better than older Wi-Fi, and this unit is described with three radios, a firewall and a ceiling mounting plate.
highlights: WPA3 security, required for Wi-Fi 6 certification

12u-wall-mount-rack.summary: A 12U wall mounted 19 inch rack cabinet for neatly housing a switch, patch panel, router and small UPS off the floor. The listing describes a tempered glass door, cooling fans, a power distribution unit (PDU) and cable managers, so it arrives ready for a small office comms room.
highlights: 12U of 19 inch mounting space (about 533 mm usable height)
Cable managers for tidy patching (per listing)

fiber-termination-kit.summary: A kit for terminating and testing fibre optic links, aimed at installers. The listing describes an LC patch panel, pigtails, a fibre cleaver, polishing films and a visual fault locator, which together let you prepare, connect and check fibre runs.
highlights: Cleaver for clean fibre cuts (per listing)
Visual fault locator to trace breaks with red light (per listing)
specs: LC patch panel, pigtails, cleaver, polishing films, visual fault locator

cat6-patch-cord-bundle-30-pcs.summary: A bundle of 30 Cat6 patch cords in assorted lengths for connecting patch panels, switches and devices. Cat6 handles Gigabit Ethernet with ease. The listing says the cords are factory tested and come with Velcro straps and a labelling kit for a tidy rack.
highlights: Velcro straps and labelling kit (per listing)

network-ups-2kva.summary: A 2 kVA rack mount UPS that keeps network equipment running through short power cuts and protects it from surges and dips. The listing describes an LCD for diagnostics, an SNMP card for remote monitoring and a battery pack.
highlights: Rack mount for 19 inch cabinets (per listing)
SNMP card for remote monitoring (per listing)

usb-to-ethernet.summary: A small adapter that adds a wired RJ45 Ethernet port to a laptop or PC through a USB port. Handy for laptops with no network port, or when Wi-Fi is weak and you need a steady cable connection.
highlights: Adds an RJ45 Ethernet port over USB
Plug and play on most modern systems
specs: Laptops and PCs without a free Ethernet port

usb-to-ethernet-with-usb-extension.summary: A USB adapter that adds a wired Ethernet port and extra USB ports at the same time. Good for laptops with few ports: plug in once and get a network cable connection plus room for a mouse, keyboard or flash drive.

type-c-to-ethernet.summary: An adapter that adds a wired RJ45 Ethernet port to a laptop, tablet or phone with a USB-C port. Ideal for slim laptops that have no network socket. The listing describes it as Gigabit.
highlights: Small and light for slim laptops

usb-wi-fi-device.summary: A plug-in USB Wi-Fi adapter that lets a desktop PC connect to Wi-Fi, or gives a laptop a second wireless connection. Simply plug it into a USB port and install the driver if the system asks for one.
highlights: Adds Wi-Fi to a desktop PC
Useful as a backup or replacement Wi-Fi card
Plugs into a standard USB port

cisco-network-switch-c-1300-48-poe.summary: A Cisco Catalyst 1300 managed switch with 48 Gigabit ports, all able to power devices such as IP cameras, phones and Wi-Fi access points over PoE+. It adds Layer 3 routing, VLANs and security features for growing businesses and branch offices, fits a standard 19 inch rack and is managed from a web browser, the command line or the Cisco Business app.
highlights: 48 Gigabit ports, all PoE+ (802.3af/at, up to 30 W per port)
4 SFP uplinks for fibre or copper modules
Layer 3: static routes, RIP v2 and IPv6 routing
Web, CLI, SNMP and Cisco Business app management

Being shielded, it should be used with shielded cable and earthed to the cabinet.

aico-face-plate-single.summary: A single port wall face plate from AICO that finishes a network point on the wall. It holds one RJ45 keystone jack, giving a clean, safe socket where a computer, phone or access point plugs in.

specs: Keystone RJ45 jack (sold separately unless stated)

aico-rj45-data-socket-single.summary: A single RJ45 data socket from AICO for ending a network cable at the wall. The installation cable is punched down at the back and a patch cord plugs into the front, giving a reliable network point for a computer, phone, camera or access point.
highlights: Punch down (IDC) termination at the back
Colour coded for T568A / T568B wiring
For wall outlets and face plates

aico-face-plate-double.summary: A two port wall face plate from AICO for network points that need two connections, for example a PC and an IP phone. It holds two RJ45 keystone jacks in one neat plate.

aico-rj45-data-socket-double.summary: A double RJ45 data socket from AICO giving two network connections at one wall point, for example a PC and an IP phone. Each port is terminated with its own installation cable at the back.

Colour coded for T568A / T568B wiring
Two connections at one wall point

aico-rj45-to-rj45-utp-through-module.summary: An AICO RJ45 to RJ45 through module (coupler) that snaps into a face plate or patch panel. Patch cords plug into both sides, so no punch down tool is needed, which makes it handy for quick installs and for joining two cords.
highlights: Snaps into keystone face plates and panels
specs: Keystone face plates and patch panels

aico-cabinet-cooling-fan.summary: A cooling fan unit from AICO for network cabinets. Fitted to the cabinet roof, it pulls warm air out so switches, routers, NVRs and UPS units run cooler and last longer.
highlights: Extracts warm air from the cabinet
Fits the roof fan opening of network cabinets
specs: Wall mounted and floor standing network cabinets

starlink-standard-kit.summary: The Starlink Standard Kit brings high speed satellite internet to homes and offices, including places fibre and mobile networks do not reach. The flat dish sits on its kickstand or a mount with a clear view of the sky and connects to the included Wi-Fi 6 router. The Starlink subscription is paid separately.
highlights: Electronic phased array dish with 110° field of view
Weatherproof dish rated IP67, works from -30 to 50 °C
Wi-Fi 6 tri-band router, up to 297 m² coverage and 235 devices
Two Ethernet ports on the router
Melts snow and runs in strong wind
Everything needed in the box, including a 15 m cable
specs: Up to 297 m², up to 235 devices
Works with up to 3 Starlink mesh nodes

biometric-door-controller.summary: A door access controller that lets people in with a fingerprint or an RFID card or fob. It is meant for offices, server rooms and gated homes that want to know who opened a door and when. The included management software license lets you enrol users, set access times and read the entry log from a computer.
highlights: Fingerprint and RFID card reading in one unit
Drives an electric lock through a built-in relay
Inputs for an exit button and a door contact
Keeps an entry log you can review in the software
specs: Relay output for an electric strike or magnetic lock

600lbs-magnetic-lock-kit.summary: A complete magnetic door lock kit with a holding force of 600 lb (about 270 kg), suitable for most single wooden, metal or glass framed doors. The lock holds the door shut while it has power and releases when the exit button is pressed or power is cut, which keeps escape routes safe. The kit comes with surface brackets, an exit button, a power supply and an LED status light.
highlights: Fail safe: the door releases when power is removed
LED shows locked or unlocked status
Exit button and power supply included
specs: Exit button, access controller or power cut

hybrid-alarm-control-panel.summary: An intruder alarm control panel that works with both wired and wireless sensors, so you can mix cabled detectors with battery powered ones where running cable is hard. A built-in GSM dialer calls or texts you when the alarm goes off, and a backup battery keeps it running during power cuts. Tamper switches raise an alarm if someone tries to open the panel.
highlights: Wired and wireless zones on one panel
GSM dialer sends alerts by call or SMS
Tamper switches protect the panel itself
specs: Hybrid (wired and wireless) intruder alarm panel

dual-tech-motion-detectors-4.summary: A set of four dual technology motion detectors for alarm systems. Each one uses both a passive infrared sensor and a microwave sensor and only signals an alarm when both agree, which greatly cuts false alarms from heat sources, sunlight or curtains moving. Pet immunity helps avoid alarms from small animals, and swivel brackets make it easy to aim each detector.
highlights: PIR plus microwave for fewer false alarms
Wired alarm relay output for standard panels
specs: Wall or corner with swivel bracket
Alarm relay for wired alarm panels
12 V DC from the alarm panel

outdoor-ir-beam-pair.summary: A pair of outdoor active infrared beams that protect a perimeter such as a wall, fence line or driveway up to 100 m long. When someone walks through the invisible beam, the receiver triggers a relay that your alarm panel or siren can use. A built-in heater helps stop condensation and mist on the lenses, and pole clamps make mounting on posts simple.
specs: Active infrared beam detector, transmitter and receiver
Pole or wall, pole clamps included

security-workstation-console.summary: An operator workstation for a guard room or control room. It combines a desk sized for two monitors with an alarm annunciator that shows which alarm has been triggered and an intercom handset for talking to gates or other posts. It gives security staff one tidy place to watch cameras and respond to events.
highlights: Built for control rooms and guard posts

hybrid-inverter-hh6ks-all-in-one-residen.summary: The KSTAR HH6KS is a 6 kW single phase hybrid inverter from the Home Series, designed to stack with KSTAR lithium battery packs into a neat all-in-one home energy system. It takes up to 9 kWp of solar, charges the batteries and keeps your home running on battery during grid outages. You can check and control the system from your phone over WiFi.
highlights: Up to 9 kWp of solar panels
Stacks with H-PACK-5.1D lithium packs (5.12 kWh each)
Up to 4.7 kW backup on battery alone
specs: 4.7 kW on battery, 6.0 kW on battery plus solar
Max. 500 V, MPPT range 120 to 450 V, start voltage 120 V
LFP, 51.2 V nominal, 5.12 kWh per pack
RS232, RS485, USB, CAN, dry contact; WiFi app monitoring
Inverter size (W x H x D)

lithium-battery-pack-for-hh6ks.summary: A 5.12 kWh lithium iron phosphate battery pack made to stack with the KSTAR HH6KS hybrid inverter. LFP chemistry is safe and long lasting, and the pack connects with quick terminals for a tidy installation. You can combine up to four packs for longer backup.
highlights: Stacks under the HH6KS as one tower

battery-to-inverter-cables-for-hh6ks.summary: A set of DC cables that connect KSTAR lithium battery packs to the HH6KS hybrid inverter. Correctly sized battery cables keep the connection cool and safe at the high currents a 48 V battery system carries. They are intended for use when installing or extending an HH6KS system.
highlights: Connects lithium packs to the HH6KS inverter
Rated for 48 V class battery systems
For new installs or adding packs
specs: Up to 100 A charge or discharge (2 packs)

hybrid-inverter-hh10ks-all-in-one-reside.summary: The KSTAR HH10KS is a 10 kW single phase hybrid inverter for larger homes and small businesses. It accepts up to 18 kWp of solar on two MPPT trackers, charges KSTAR lithium battery packs and supplies up to 9.5 kW of backup power from the batteries during outages. Monitoring and settings are available on your phone through WiFi.
highlights: Up to 18 kWp of solar on 2 MPPT trackers
Up to 9.5 kW backup from battery
specs: 9.5 kW on battery, 10.0 kW on battery plus solar
Max. 500 V, MPPT range 60 to 450 V, start voltage 120 V
2 trackers, 1 string each, max. 27 A per tracker
LFP, 51.2 V nominal, 5.12 kWh per pack
RS232, RS485, USB, CAN, dry contact; WiFi app monitoring
Inverter size (W x H x D)

lithium-battery-pack-for-hh10ks.summary: A 5.12 kWh rack mount lithium iron phosphate battery pack for the KSTAR HH10KS hybrid inverter. It is rated for about 6000 cycles, so it suits daily solar charging for many years. Packs sit in a rack and can be combined for more storage.

battery-to-inverter-cables-for-hh10ks.summary: A set of DC cables that connect KSTAR lithium battery packs to the HH10KS hybrid inverter. The HH10KS can move up to 200 A to and from its batteries, so properly sized cables matter for safety and efficiency. Use them when installing or expanding an HH10KS system.
highlights: Connects lithium packs to the HH10KS inverter
For new installs or adding packs
specs: Up to 200 A charge or discharge (4 packs)

off-grid-inverter-knight-g2-6kva-48v.summary: The KSTAR Knight is a 6 kVA off-grid solar inverter for homes and businesses without a reliable grid. It combines a solar MPPT charger, a mains or generator charger and a pure sine wave inverter in one wall mounted unit, and works with both lead acid and lithium 48 V batteries. Up to six units can run in parallel for bigger loads.
highlights: Solar charging up to 6700 W on one MPPT
Works with lead acid or lithium batteries and generators
specs: 230 V, 170 to 280 Vac (PC mode) or 90 to 280 Vac (appliance mode), 50 / 60 Hz
Max. 500 Vdc open circuit, MPPT 120 to 450 Vdc, 1 tracker
48 V lead acid or 51.2 V LiFePO4
RS232, USB, dry contact; optional RS485, CAN, WiFi

lithium-battery-5-12kwh-ip21-h-pack-5-1.summary: The KSTAR H-PACK-5.1 is a 5.12 kWh lithium iron phosphate battery for home solar and backup systems. It pairs with KSTAR Home Series hybrid inverters and is built with laser welded cells and quick-connect terminals. The rack mount version shown can be combined up to eight packs for more storage.
highlights: CAN and RS485 communication with the inverter
Up to 8 packs in parallel (rack version)

battery-to-inverter-cables-for-h-pack-5-.summary: A set of DC cables to connect a KSTAR H-PACK-5.1 lithium battery to its hybrid inverter. Each pack works at a nominal 51.2 V and can supply several kilowatts, so correctly sized leads keep the connection safe and efficient. Use them when installing a new pack or adding one to an existing system.
highlights: For new installs or extra packs

online-ups-1kva-single-phase-mp-1k-s.summary: The KSTAR MP 1K S is a 1 kVA online double conversion UPS in a tower case with batteries built in. It feeds your equipment from its own inverter at all times, so computers, network gear and other sensitive loads get clean, stable power with zero transfer time when the mains fails. A wide input range copes well with unstable grid voltage and generators.
highlights: USB, RS232 and SNMP card slot
specs: 110 to 300 Vac (176 to 280 Vac at full load)
Pure sine wave, THDv 3% or less (linear load)
0 ms mains to battery, 4 ms to bypass (typical)
USB, RS232, intelligent slot for SNMP or dry contact card

online-ups-10kva-single-phase-mp-pro-10k.summary: The KSTAR MP Pro 10K S is a 10 kVA single phase online UPS with internal batteries and built-in parallel capability. online-ups-10kva-3-phase-ydc3310s.summary: The KSTAR YDC3310 S is a 10 kVA three phase online UPS from the YDC3300 series, with 20 batteries built into the cabinet. It is aimed at data rooms, factories and buildings with three phase loads.

online-ups-60kva-3-phase-ydc3360h.summary: The KSTAR YDC3360H is a 60 kVA three phase online UPS from the YDC3300 series, built as a long run unit that connects to an external battery bank. Its transformerless double conversion design gives high efficiency, and a wide input range lets it ride through poor grid conditions without using the batteries. Several units can be paralleled for growth or redundancy.
